name: Nylon coif
description: A close padded hood of layered nylon that covers the head, neck and forehead and spreads over the shoulders. Worn under a helmet as a cushion, it still turns a glancing blow on its own.
notes: Standing upright as on a shelf, 330 mm across the shoulder curtain and 310 mm tall: a padded ranger-green nylon hood over the crown, the face opening at +z drawn as a dark patch with a bound rim, quilted rings round the flared curtain and a buttoned chin strap. CHECK VOLUME (x66): the model stands as a hollow hood round a head-sized space, while the reference volume is the cloth itself packed flat. Slot `head`: the coif is padding worn under a helmet, which one head slot cannot express; it needs a layer under the helmet once Deadvox has one. Protection values are a judgement for layered padding: strong against blunt blows, fair against cuts, weak against points. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored. Slot hood: worn under a helmet, which takes head.
